products.title: Silver Line
products.descriptionHtml:
The Foundation of Confidence

Clean lines and considered detail form a quiet foundation for the day. Silver Line is FANN’s everyday collection, expressed through a restrained palette and a structured silhouette.

Choose White, Black or Navy as the starting point for your personal expression.

Concept preview. The images show a design in development. Final materials, construction, fit, colours and availability will be confirmed before release.

products.title: Gold Line
products.descriptionHtml:
Precision in Motion

Rich colour meets a precise graphic structure. Gold Line explores a more expressive daily essential, with sculpted panel lines and warm accents that trace the form.

The initial palette spans Maroon, Black, Ivory, Purple, Blue and Green. Maroon is the first garment concept; the palette reference establishes the other five colour directions.

Concept preview. The images show a design in development. Final materials, construction, fit, colours and availability will be confirmed before release.
